title: Introduction to Computers
parentNote: If you have a computer or laptop at home, let your child watch you turn it on and shut it down properly before this unit — seeing the real "Shut Down" step makes Q27 much easier to remember.
learnBullets: What a **computer** is, and why we call it a "smart machine"
A computer **follows instructions** — it cannot think or decide on its own
How to **turn ON** and **safely shut down** a computer
Everyday things a computer can help us do
learnItFirst:
**A computer is an electronic machine** that follows instructions to store information, do calculations, and show us pictures, words, and videos.

```
YOU give an instruction  →  COMPUTER follows it  →  COMPUTER shows the result
```

**The most important rule:** A computer has **no brain or feelings of its own**. It cannot think, decide, or do anything unless a person tells it what to do. It is smart because it follows instructions super fast — not because it thinks by itself.

**Turning a computer ON and OFF the right way:**
| Step | What to do |
|---|---|
| Turning ON | Press the **Power button** |
| Turning OFF | **Save your work**, close programs, then use **Shut Down** — never just pull the plug! |

### 🧠 How to Solve — 3 Easy Steps
1. **Ask:** does this need a person to give an instruction first? (The answer is almost always YES.)
2. **Remember:** a computer is a machine, not a living, thinking being.
3. **Think** about the SAFE way to do something (like shutting down) before picking an answer.

questions.content: What is a computer?

options.A: A machine that helps us do work

questions.why: A computer is an electronic machine, not a living thing

questions.content: Does a computer have its own brain and feelings like a human?
questions.why: A computer has no brain or feelings of its own

questions.content: Which of these is a computer?
questions.why: A desktop is a real computer; the others are not

questions.content: A computer is often called a "___ machine" because it works so fast and smartly.
questions.why: A computer is called a smart machine because it follows instructions quickly

questions.content: What do we press to turn ON a computer?
questions.why: The power button turns a computer ON

questions.content: Which of these can a computer do?
questions.why: Computers store information; they cannot eat, sleep, or grow

questions.content: A computer needs someone to give it instructions. Who gives these instructions?
questions.why: A person must give the computer instructions to follow

questions.content: Which of these is NOT something a computer can do on its own, without any instructions?

options.C: Play a video when told to

questions.why: A computer cannot think or decide on its own — everything else needs a "when told to" instruction

questions.content: What should you do before turning off a computer properly?

options.C: Shut it down properly using the Shut Down option

questions.why: This protects the computer and saves your work

questions.content: A computer that you can easily carry around is called a:
questions.why: A laptop is designed to be carried around easily

questions.content: Which of these words best describes a computer?
questions.why: A computer is an electronic machine

questions.content: A computer follows a set of step-by-step instructions called a:
questions.why: A set of step-by-step instructions is called a program

questions.content: Is this TRUE or FALSE? "A computer can think and feel just like a person."
questions.why: A computer cannot think or feel like a person

questions.content: Which of these is a correct step while shutting down a computer safely?
questions.why: Saving your work before shutting down keeps it safe

questions.content: A desktop computer usually stays:

options.A: In one place on a table

questions.why: A desktop computer is meant to stay in one place

questions.content: Which of these is an example of a "smart machine" like a computer?

options.D: A calculator that can also store pictures and videos

questions.why: This is an electronic device that follows instructions, like a computer

questions.content: Why do we call a computer "smart"?

options.A: It can quickly follow instructions, store, and show information
options.D: It can talk on its own without instructions

questions.why: This is why we call a computer "smart," not because it thinks on its own

questions.content: If you don't give a computer any instructions, what will it do?
questions.why: Without instructions, a computer simply waits

questions.content: What is the FIRST thing you should do when you sit down to use a computer?

options.B: Turn it ON using the power button

questions.why: You must turn it on before you can use it

questions.content: Which of these tasks can a computer help you do?
questions.why: A computer can help with drawing, writing, and playing learning games

questions.content: When a computer is shut down the WRONG way (like just cutting the power), what could happen?
questions.why: Cutting power suddenly can lose work that wasn't saved

questions.content: A computer is different from a TV because a computer can:

options.A: Follow many different instructions we give it

questions.why: A computer can be told to do many different tasks; a TV mostly just shows channels

questions.content: Which is TRUE about computers?
questions.why: Computers run on electricity

questions.content: Which of these would you NOT use a computer for?
questions.why: A computer cannot be used for drinking water — it's not a real task for it

questions.content: A computer stores information so that we can:
questions.why: Storing information lets us use it again whenever we need it

questions.content: Riya says, "My computer decided to make me a birthday card all by itself, with no help from me." Is this possible?

options.C: No, someone must have given it instructions to do that
options.D: Yes, computers can decide things on their own

questions.why: A computer cannot decide anything on its own

questions.content: Which is the correct order of steps to safely turn OFF a computer?

options.B: Shut Down → Save work → Close programs
options.C: Save work → Close programs → Shut Down

questions.why: This is the safe order for shutting down

questions.content: A computer follows instructions VERY fast. If a person can add 2 numbers in 5 seconds, a computer could add thousands of numbers in:
questions.why: Computers follow instructions and calculate much faster than people

questions.content: Why is it important to shut down a computer properly instead of just switching off the power?

options.A: It makes no difference at all
options.D: To protect the computer and save your work safely

questions.why: Proper shut down avoids losing work or harming the computer

questions.content: Sam's computer is switched on, but he hasn't typed or clicked anything for 10 minutes. What will the computer most likely do?

options.D: Wait patiently for the next instruction

questions.why: A computer just waits until it is given another instruction
